cases.name: cash
cases.question: Mijozlardan jami qancha pul tushgan? Faqat jami summani ko‘rsat.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS cash_uzs FROM payments

cases.name: gross_profit
cases.question: Yakunlangan buyurtmalar bo‘yicha yalpi foyda qancha? Faqat summani ko‘rsat.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount-total_cost) AS gross_profit FROM orders WHERE status='completed'

cases.name: refunds
cases.question: 2026-yil oktabrda mijozlarga qaytarilgan to‘lovlarning jami summasi qancha?

cases.name: completed_sales
cases.question: Yakunlangan buyurtmalarning jami sotuv summasi qancha?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS sales FROM orders WHERE status='completed'

cases.name: branch_ranking
cases.question: 2026-yil oktabrda yakunlangan buyurtmalar summasi eng katta bo‘lgan uchta filial qaysi? Faqat filial nomi va summasini kamayish tartibida ko‘rsat.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT b.name AS branch, SUM(o.total_amount) AS sales FROM orders o JOIN branches b ON b.id=o.branch_id WHERE o.status='completed' AND o.order_date>='2026-10-01' AND o.order_date<'2026-11-01' GROUP BY b.id,b.name ORDER BY sales DESC,b.id LIMIT 3

cases.name: oop_expense
cases.question: 2026-yil oktabrda jami operatsion xarajat qancha bo‘lgan? Faqat summani ko‘rsat.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS expenses FROM pnl_expenses WHERE expense_date >= '2026-10-01' AND expense_date < '2026-11-01'

cases.name: cash_october
cases.question: 2026-yil oktabrda to‘lov sanasi bo‘yicha mijozlardan qancha pul kelib tushgan?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS cash_uzs FROM payments WHERE payment_date >= '2026-10-01' AND payment_date < '2026-11-01'

cases.name: distinct_buyers
cases.question: 2026-yil oktabrda nechta turli mijozning kamida bitta buyurtmasi yakunlangan? Faqat sonini ko‘rsat.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) AS buyers FROM orders WHERE status='completed' AND order_date >= '2026-10-01' AND order_date < '2026-11-01'

cases.name: after_tax
cases.question: Barcha soliqlar va foiz xarajatlaridan keyin qolgan sof foyda qancha?

cases.name: avg_check
cases.question: 2026-yil oktabrda yakunlangan buyurtmaning o‘rtacha summasi qancha? So‘mgacha yaxlitla.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_amount),0) AS avg_check FROM orders WHERE status='completed' AND order_date >= '2026-10-01' AND order_date < '2026-11-01'

cases.name: overdue
cases.question: Yig‘ilgan qoldiqlar bo‘yicha muddati o‘tgan debitorlik qarzining jami summasi qancha?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(overdue_receivable) AS overdue FROM debt_settlements

cases.name: smallest_branch
cases.question: 2026-yil sentabrda yakunlangan buyurtma summasi eng kichik bo‘lgan ikkita filial qaysi? Faqat filial nomi va summasini o‘sish tartibida chiqar.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT b.name AS branch,SUM(o.total_amount) AS sales FROM orders o JOIN branches b ON b.id=o.branch_id WHERE o.status='completed' AND o.order_date>='2026-09-01' AND o.order_date<'2026-10-01' GROUP BY b.id,b.name ORDER BY sales,b.id LIMIT 2

cases.name: stock_skus
cases.question: Ombor qoldig‘i noldan katta bo‘lgan turli mahsulotlar jami nechta?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS products FROM warehouse_stocks WHERE quantity>0

cases.name: completed_count
cases.question: 2026-yil oktabrda jami nechta buyurtma yakunlangan?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE status='completed' AND order_date >= '2026-10-01' AND order_date < '2026-11-01'

cases.name: cancelled_count
cases.question: 2026-yil sentabrda bekor qilingan buyurtmalar soni qancha?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled FROM orders WHERE status='cancelled' AND order_date >= '2026-09-01' AND order_date < '2026-10-01'

cases.name: weighted_margin
cases.question: Yakunlangan buyurtmalarning umumiy yalpi marjasi necha foiz? Yalpi foydani jami sotuvga bo‘l va foizni ikki kasrgacha yaxlitla.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(total_amount-total_cost)/NULLIF(SUM(total_amount),0),2) AS pct FROM orders WHERE status='completed'

cases.name: invoice_total
cases.question: 2026-yil oktabrda faktura sanasi bo‘yicha yozilgan hisob-fakturalarning jami summasi qancha?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS invoiced FROM invoices WHERE invoice_date >= '2026-10-01' AND invoice_date < '2026-11-01'

cases.name: cash_method
cases.question: 2026-yil oktabrda to‘lov usullari bo‘yicha qancha pul tushgan? Faqat usul kodi va summani kamayish tartibida ko‘rsat.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT payment_method AS method,SUM(amount) AS cash FROM payments WHERE payment_date >= '2026-10-01' AND payment_date < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY cash DESC,payment_method

cases.name: revenue_missing_period
cases.question: Savdo nega pasaydi?

cases.name: unpaid_balance
cases.question: Debitorlik hisob-kitoblarida mijozlardan olinadigan jami qoldiq qancha? Faqat summani ko‘rsat.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(balance_receivable) AS balance FROM debt_settlements
